module roman.numerals
  purpose: Convert between integers and Roman numerals.

public type RomanError is one of
  OutOfRange(value: Integer)
  InvalidFormat(text: Text)
end

public function to_roman(value: Integer)
  returns Text
  or fails with RomanError
  purpose: Convert an integer from 1 to 3999 to a Roman numeral.
  example: to_roman(value: 1994) is "MCMXCIV"
  example: to_roman(value: 58) is "LVIII"

  if value is less than 1 or value is greater than 3999 then
    fail with OutOfRange(value: value)
  end

  let mutable result be ""
  let mutable remaining be value

  let mappings be [
    Mapping(value: 1000, numeral: "M"),
    Mapping(value: 900, numeral: "CM"),
    Mapping(value: 500, numeral: "D"),
    Mapping(value: 400, numeral: "CD"),
    Mapping(value: 100, numeral: "C"),
    Mapping(value: 90, numeral: "XC"),
    Mapping(value: 50, numeral: "L"),
    Mapping(value: 40, numeral: "XL"),
    Mapping(value: 10, numeral: "X"),
    Mapping(value: 9, numeral: "IX"),
    Mapping(value: 5, numeral: "V"),
    Mapping(value: 4, numeral: "IV"),
    Mapping(value: 1, numeral: "I")
  ]

  for each mapping in mappings
    repeat until remaining is less than mapping.value
      set result to result + mapping.numeral
      set remaining to remaining - mapping.value
    end
  end

  return result
end

public function from_roman(text: Text)
  returns Integer
  or fails with RomanError
  purpose: Convert a Roman numeral to an integer from 1 to 3999.
  example: from_roman(text: "MCMXCIV") is 1994
  example: from_roman(text: "LVIII") is 58

  let trimmed be text.trim().to_upper()

  if trimmed.is_empty() then
    fail with InvalidFormat(text: text)
  end

  let values be {
    "M": 1000,
    "D": 500,
    "C": 100,
    "L": 50,
    "X": 10,
    "V": 5,
    "I": 1
  }

  let chars be trimmed.characters()
  let mutable result be 0
  let mutable index be 0

  repeat until index is at least chars.length()
    let current_char be chars.at(index) otherwise fail with InvalidFormat(text: text)
    let current_value be values.get(current_char) otherwise fail with InvalidFormat(text: text)

    let next_index be index + 1
    if next_index is less than chars.length() then
      let next_char be chars.at(next_index) otherwise fail with InvalidFormat(text: text)
      let next_value be values.get(next_char) otherwise fail with InvalidFormat(text: text)

      if current_value is less than next_value then
        set result to result + next_value - current_value
        set index to next_index + 1
      otherwise
        set result to result + current_value
        set index to next_index
      end
    otherwise
      set result to result + current_value
      set index to next_index
    end
  end

  if result is less than 1 or result is greater than 3999 then
    fail with OutOfRange(value: result)
  end

  return result
end

type Mapping
  has value: Integer
  has numeral: Text
end
